architecture_statement: LLM call happens in the Agent/Host; MCP server does not call the LLM.

result.instructions: This MCP server exposes ticket details and escalation history tools. The LLM that calls these tools runs in the Host/Agent; this server never calls any LLM.

field_annotations.id: Request identifier echoed back by the server to correlate async request/response.
field_annotations.method: RPC method to invoke ('initialize' establishes session & protocol negotiation).
field_annotations.params: Parameters supplied by host (protocolVersion, capabilities, clientInfo).
field_annotations.result: Server capability declaration and metadata payload upon successful initialization.

conversations.architecture_note: LLM call happens in the Agent/Host; MCP server does not call the LLM.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description:
Retrieve the current status, priority, subject, and resolution notes for a support ticket.

Use this tool when:
- The user asks about a ticket's current state (e.g. 'What is the status of TCK-4471?').
- You need the ticket subject, category, or resolution notes before fetching history.

ticket_id.description:
Ticket identifier in the format TCK-NNNN (e.g. TCK-4471).
       Do NOT pass raw numbers like '4471'; always include the 'TCK-' prefix.

tools.name: get_escalation_history
tools.description:
Retrieve the full chronological escalation and action history for a ticket.

Use this tool when:
- The user asks what happened with a ticket, who handled it, or how it was resolved.
- You need the audit trail of agents, supervisors, or automated actions taken.

ticket_id.description:
Ticket identifier in the format TCK-NNNN (e.g. TCK-4471).
       Do NOT pass raw numbers like '4471'; always include the 'TCK-' prefix.

field_annotations.method: Operation 'tools/list' dynamically retrieves all available tools and schemas.
field_annotations.result.tools: Array of tool definitions containing name, description, and JSON schema.

conversations.architecture_note: LLM call happens in the Agent/Host; MCP server does not call the LLM.
